title: Foreign-owned US LLC with no income still files Form 5472

link.label: Does a foreign-owned LLC file Form 5472? (MFA)

hook.text: Foreign owner of a US LLC with *$0 income?*
hook.sub: Myth: no income, nothing to file.

items.l: Money you put in or take out counts

beats.sub: Per form, per IRS Form 5472 instructions
beats.note: More if it stays unfiled after notice.

items.t: Get an EIN for the LLC
File by the Form 1120 due date

captions.instagram:
Foreign owner of a US single-member LLC with no income? 🌍 Myth: no income means nothing to file.

Fact: a foreign-owned US LLC files Form 5472 with a pro forma Form 1120 for a year with reportable transactions, and money you put in or take out counts.

✔️ Get an EIN for the LLC.
✔️ List every transfer between you and the LLC.
✔️ File by the Form 1120 due date. The IRS penalty for missing it is steep.

Comment 5472 and we'll send the answer page.

General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.youtube_title: Foreign-Owned US LLC With $0 Income? Form 5472 Still Due
captions.youtube_description: A US disregarded entity wholly owned by a foreign person files a pro forma Form 1120 with Form 5472 attached. Reportable transactions include contributions to and distributions from the entity. The penalty for failure to file is $25,000. Source: IRS Instructions for Form 5472. General information, not advice for your situation.
